messages:
tanya_sales: Procurement at NorthPoint asked for HSM attestation for any transient inference cache. They said no HSM = no PO. Can we provide a vendor-signed risk acceptance?

ev an_sec: Heard. Do we have their exact SIG clause?

tanya_sales: 'Please confirm vendor supports customer-managed HSM attestation for transient caches, or provide compensating controls and a vendor-signed risk acceptance.'

rui_infra: Short: hosted = no HSM for in-memory caches. Dedicated/Private = can attach customer HSM/KMS. We should prepare: (1) customer paragraph, (2) internal risk memo, (3) sign-off path.

meera_prod: Draft compensating controls for hosted (internal):
```
- Ephemeral in-memory cache only; no disk persistence.
- Default TTL 60s, configurable to 15s.
- CMEK for persisted artifacts (logs, traces) with customer keys.
- mTLS and least-privilege roles for all services.
- Immutable audit logs for key access stored in customer region, 12mo retention.
- Manual signed integrity snapshot available on request until automation (~6-8 weeks).
```

ev an_sec: Residual risk = "moderate" for typical customers, "elevated" for regulated financials. I'll prepare the internal risk acceptance template and request CISO sign-off.

logan_legal: External wording suggestion (short): "Hosted Redwood inference uses transient, in-memory caches with strict isolation and short time-to-live. While hardware-backed attestation for ephemeral memory is provided via Dedicated/private deployments, Redwood offers compensating controls and a vendor risk acceptance for hosted POCs. Please contact your account team for Dedicated options."

sec-bot: Created SEC-2140 for NorthPoint HSM exception request. Reviewers: evan_sec, logan_legal, ciso. https://redwood.internal/tickets/SEC-2140

tanya_sales: Need to send to procurement today. Evan/Logan/meera can you drop the final one-paragraph and confirm expected ETA for manual attestation package?

meera_prod: ETA for manual package = 3 business days first delivery. Customer paragraph below (ready to send after legal review):
"Redwood hosted inference leverages transient, in-memory caches with strict tenant isolation and short TTLs. While hosted mode does not expose hardware-backed attestation for ephemeral memory, Redwood provides customer-managed encryption for persisted artifacts, detailed auditability, and an approved vendor risk acceptance for POC deployments. Dedicated and Private deployment options are available for customers requiring hardware-backed key attestation."

logan_legal: Minor edit applied (soften): "Hosted inference leverages transient, in-memory caches with strict isolation and short TTLs. Hardware-backed attestation for ephemeral memory is available for Dedicated/private deployments; for hosted deployments, Redwood employs customer-managed encryption for persisted artifacts, enhanced auditability, and can provide a vendor risk acceptance for POC deployments."

ev an_sec: I will attach the internal memo and route SEC-2140 for CISO signature today. Once signed, Tanya send to procurement.

tanya_sales: Thanks all 44d
